title: firestore.rules exists
remediation: Add firestore.rules and reference it from firebase.json.

title: Firestore rules end with a catch-all deny
remediation: Append `match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if false; }` as the last block.

sources.title: Firebase launch checklist — Cloud Firestore: configure Security Rules

title: No rule grants write to any signed-in user
remediation: Scope writes to the owner or an allowlist document, never to `request.auth != null` alone.

title: storage.rules exists when Storage is configured
remediation: Add storage.rules with a catch-all deny.

title: .firebaserc default project is not a demo id
remediation: Point `projects.default` at the real project id; keep `demo-*` only under an emulator alias.

title: Separate project aliases for non-production and production

check.prompt: Confirm .firebaserc or deploy scripts target distinct Firebase projects for dev/test vs production, and that production has a lien or Prod environment tag.

remediation: Create a separate production project; add a project lien.

title: Unused auth providers disabled; anonymous auth off unless required

check.prompt: List enabled sign-in providers and authorized domains in the console (no CLI listing exists). Confirm anonymous auth is disabled unless the app needs it and the production domain is authorized.

remediation: Disable unused providers; add the production domain to authorized domains.

title: App Check enforced for every supported service

check.prompt: Check whether App Check is enforced for Firestore, Storage, Functions and Auth. Record enforcement state per service.

remediation: Enable and enforce App Check; this is a Change-tier action.

title: Budget alerts configured on the billing account

check.prompt: Confirm a budget with alert thresholds exists for the billing account (budgets notify, they do not cap spend).

remediation: Create a budget alert; consider a spend cap function. Change-tier.

title: API keys restricted to the APIs they need

check.prompt: Inspect API key restrictions in the Cloud console: application restrictions (HTTP referrers) and API restrictions set for the web key.

remediation: Restrict the browser key by referrer and by API.
